text: Conflict of laws problems become more complex and pose a much greater threat to the entire system of regulatory competition once a jurisdiction markets its corporate law as a separate product under Type B competition.
citation: Christian Kirchner, Richard W. Painter, Wulf A. Kaal, Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro (2004). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=617681

isBasedOn.name: Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro

abstract: Conflict of laws problems, however, become more complex, and are a much greater threat to the entire system of regulatory competition, once a jurisdiction markets its corporate law as a separate product in Type B regulatory competition.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: Type B regulatory competition under the incorporation theory
